status: alpha tool, wiki cross-link, and staged editor layer
sourceNotes: Legacy fifth-edition mechanical phrasing must be converted before reusable public release.
Rules-facing text should separate open d20 mechanics from setting prose.
Alpha modules are operational campaign aids and are not final balanced rules text.
The seed wiki layer now cross-links lore entries with related tools and generators.
Staged editors should be fully built one at a time. Stage 1 is the Floating Island / Skyland Editor; Stage 2 is the Settlement / Skyport Editor; Stage 3 is the Airship / Vessel Editor.

modules.title: Kaysender Hypertext Wiki
modules.description: Searchable setting index for world lore, peoples, nations, cities, factions, ships, creatures, equipment, and rules notes.

modules.title: Floating Island Generator and Skyland Editor
modules.description: Generates and edits detailed floating island profiles with stability, drift, water, food, ecology, faction, route, settlement, market, and encounter outputs.

modules.title: World Map and Route Generator
modules.description: Builds abstract map regions, trade winds, safe lanes, dragon airspace, storm belts, and pirate routes.

modules.title: Settlement Generator and Skyport Editor
modules.description: Generates and edits detailed settlements with population scale, government, defenses, economy, water, food, trade access, faction presence, social stress, civic assets, local secrets, crisis clocks, and optional island-profile inheritance.

modules.title: City Center and District Generator
modules.description: Generates markets, docks, foundries, temples, slums, academies, guild quarters, and noble districts.

modules.title: Population Generator
modules.description: Creates ancestry mix, occupations, militia numbers, poverty pressure, specialists, disease risk, and migration pressure.

modules.title: Shop and Market Stall Generator
modules.description: Creates legal shops, traveling merchants, guild vendors, black-market dealers, counterfeiters, and supply shortages.

modules.title: Airship and Vessel Generator and Editor
modules.description: Generates and edits detailed airship profiles with vessel class, hull culture, core type, purpose, legal status, crew, cargo, armament, defenses, condition, maintenance pressure, route compatibility, faction entanglement, hidden problems, missions, and optional island/settlement inheritance.

modules.title: Airship Core and Construction Builder
modules.description: Framework for building Dwarven, Elven, Dragon Kin, Gnomish, and Human hybrid airship cores.

modules.title: Crafting, Gadget, and Equipment Creator
modules.description: Creates potions, alchemical oils, weather gear, communication devices, ship gadgets, and survival devices.

modules.title: Supply, Water, and Survival Planner
modules.description: Tracks water, food, crew size, livestock, climate pressure, spoilage, rain capture, and shortage events.

modules.title: Faction and Guild Generator
modules.description: Creates public purpose, hidden purpose, fleet details, territory, leadership, rivals, reputation, and hooks.

modules.title: Black Market and Piracy Generator
modules.description: Creates criminal groups, cover identities, contraband, hideouts, victims, bribe networks, and evidence trails.

modules.title: Kaysender Encounter Generator
modules.description: Creates sky-route, city, skyport, island, storm, abyss, dragon-dominion, and pirate-zone encounters.

modules.title: Sky Ecology and Bestiary Generator
modules.description: Generates sky creatures, herd behavior, valuable materials, diseases, predators, and conservation pressure.

modules.title: NPC and Crew Generator
modules.description: Creates ship crew, faction agents, shopkeepers, settlers, guides, engineers, captains, and specialists.

modules.title: Job Board and Campaign Hook Generator
modules.description: Creates escort, salvage, rescue, survey, smuggling, monster hunt, water delivery, tithe resistance, and repair jobs.

modules.title: Draconic Tithe and Settlement Crisis Generator
modules.description: Builds Dragon Lord tribute demands, local shortages, enforcer fleets, collaborators, resistance cells, and crisis clocks.

modules.title: Organization Operations Tracker
modules.description: Tracks finance, morale, logistics, security, law pressure, innovation, reputation, staffing, and supply chains.
